question: How many states and union territories together have only one seat each in Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9**__.

 
• **States and union territories together have only one seat each in Lok Sabha**

 
 
• ​Mizoram
 
• Nagaland
 
• Sikkim
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands
 
• Chandigarh
